text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Strong authentication helps ensure that only the right people can access sensitive areas, for example by using passwords and two-factor verification. Developers must also validate all input from users to prevent attacks. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, often happen when input is not checked properly. By following these basic security practices, developers can build safer websites and protect both their users and their data from harm.
